regimeSub: 10Y pulls back from 5.01% to 4.96% but bear steepening thesis intact with Warsh hiking cycle far from over.
themes: Fed Chair Warsh's Sept 16 hike to 4.0% + 'more tightening ahead' guidance keeps 2Y pinned at 4.76% → real rates at +70bps vs 3.7% Aug CPI signal restrictive policy with growth slowing to 1.5% Q2 GDP
10Y eases 5bps from 5.01% to 4.96% → tactical short-covering but 2s10s at +20bps steepening from 4.74% one month ago reflects fiscal premium + Warsh credibility test against sticky 3.3% core PCE
Brent spikes to $98.81 (+1.5%) as Iran-US Hormuz clashes resume per Insurance Business → oil pass-through to CPI constrains Fed pivot, gold at $4372 signals inflation hedge bid remains strong
BOK reactive hiking cycle continues after Aug back-to-back hikes to 3.0% → USDKRW at 1351 still 100bps rate gap pressure but won strengthening from 1382 reflects SK HBM export boom with KOSPI at 7038

headline: Warsh's hiking cycle meets persistent 3.7% CPI and 1.5% GDP as 10Y pulls back from 5% but stagflation grind continues with Brent near $99 on Hormuz escalation.
